chad.definition:
n. a small piece of paper that is supposed to be removed when a hole is punched in a card or paper tape
n. a landlocked desert republic in north-central Africa; was under French control until 1960
n. a family of Afroasiatic tonal languages (mostly two tones) spoken in the regions west and south of Lake Chad in north central Africa

chadband.translation: 巧言令色的伪君子(原为英国作家 Dickens 所著小说 Bleak House 中的人物)

chaddock reflex.translation: [医] 查多克氏反射(足外踝反射)

chaddock's sign.translation: [医] 查多克氏征(足外踝征)

chadian.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Chad
a. of or relating to or characteristic of the Republic of Chad or its people or language
chadian.translation:
n. 乍得人
a. 乍得的, 乍得人的

chadians.translation:
